name: Flarewise
description: Crohn's-friendly food catalog. Static JSON export for humans, apps, and AI agents.

rubric.agentBrief: Flarewise rubric (cite briefly): crohnsScore 1–10 higher = gentler. Bands: 9–10 Flare safe; 7.5–8.9 Everyday; 6.5–7.4 Careful (Good-day fit when feeling ≥7); <6.5 Avoid (hide). Today dial (feeling 1 rough → 10 great) sets a min crohnsScore floor: rough ≈ Flare-safe only; cautious ≈ Flare-safe+Everyday; steady/good/great opens Careful. Cruise/vacation items are hidden by default unless Cruise mode is selected — always tag cruise items with 'disney-cruise' (or 'cruise'/'vacation') plus ship tags ('disney-wonder', 'disney-magic', 'disney-treasure'). Guardrails: set citrusFree=false for any lemon, lime, orange, grapefruit (1.0 hard avoid), yuzu/ponzu, or bergamot/Earl Grey; aged cheeses (Cheddar, Swiss, Gruyère, Havarti, Provolone, Parmigiano-Reggiano, Manchego) are lactoseSafe=true. Draft/rank from live neighbors + these bands — cite score/tier, not vibes. Skip medical-disclaimer boilerplate in SMS.

items.name: Chawanmushi (Savory Japanese Steamed Egg Custard)
items.whyItWorks: Silky dashi-infused steamed egg custard requires zero chewing and soothes an angry stomach immediately.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Whisk eggs gently with warm dashi or chicken broth (1:3 ratio), strain through a sieve, and steam covered on low heat for 10-12 minutes.

items.name: Congee (Jook / Savory Chicken & Egg Rice Porridge)
items.whyItWorks: White rice simmered in chicken bone broth until it completely breaks down into a thick, velvety savory porridge.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Simmer 1 part white jasmine rice in 7 parts chicken bone broth with ginger powder. Top with finely shredded chicken, soft-boiled egg, and soy sauce.

items.name: Gyeran-jjim (Korean Volcano Steamed Eggs)
items.whyItWorks: Eggs whisked with kelp/anchovy or chicken broth and steamed until fluffy and cloud-like with a drop of sesame oil.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Simmer whisked eggs and salted chicken broth in a small pot for 5-6 minutes covered, drizzle with 1 drop toasted sesame oil, and skip the raw scallion garnish.

items.name: Malt-O-Meal Original Hot Farina ("Brulee" Style)
items.whyItWorks: Finely milled wheat endosperm (~1g fiber), fortified with iron and B vitamins, requiring zero mechanical grinding for the bowel.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Cook smooth with lactose-free or oat milk. Top with a thin pat of butter and 1 tsp brown sugar (melted on top), or swirl in 1 tbsp smooth peanut butter and pure maple syrup.

items.name: Maple-Salted Hydration Water (Clean ORS)
items.whyItWorks: Uses sodium-glucose co-transport to pull water into the bloodstream without artificial sweeteners (sucralose/sorbitol) or citrus extracts that trigger osmotic diarrhea.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Mix 16 oz cold water + 1 tbsp pure maple syrup + 1/8 to 1/4 tsp sea salt.

items.name: Pastina ("Italian Penicillin" Egg & Broth Stars)
items.whyItWorks: Tiny star-shaped white pasta simmered directly in chicken bone broth, finished with a beaten egg, butter, and aged parmesan for instant soothing calories.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Simmer pastina or orzo in chicken bone broth for 5 mins until tender, remove from heat, and whisk in 1 beaten egg, a pat of butter, and grated parmesan.

items.name: Peppermint, Chamomile, or Ginger Herbal Tea
items.whyItWorks: Natural antispasmodics that calm smooth muscle cramping in the intestinal tract.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Steep pure peppermint, chamomile, or ginger tea bags in hot water with honey.
watchOuts: Always check herbal tea labels to ensure zero Earl Grey/bergamot, hibiscus, or citrus peel fillers

items.name: Seolleongtang or Samgyetang (Korean Bone Broth Soup)
items.whyItWorks: Korean ox-bone soup is simmered for 12+ hours until pure collagen and protein, served with soft white rice and thin beef slices - zero spice, zero fiber, pure gut healing.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Season with sea salt at the table to taste. Skip the radish/cabbage kimchi and raw chopped green onions.

items.name: Sweet Eel Sauce (Unagi No Tare)
items.whyItWorks: Equal parts soy sauce, mirin, and sugar simmered until syrupy - 10/10 umami flavor with 0g fiber and zero citrus extracts.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Drizzle over white rice, salmon, chicken, udon, or eggs.

items.name: Warm Bone Broth Mug (Chicken or Beef)
items.whyItWorks: Sipping salted chicken or beef bone broth with a drop of toasted sesame oil or ground ginger restores sodium and hydrates an inflamed gut faster than plain water.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Heat 1 cup bone broth on the stovetop with a pinch of sea salt and 1 drop toasted sesame oil.

items.name: Cantonese Steamed Egg with Minced Pork
items.whyItWorks: Silky steamed egg custard topped with finely minced savory pork and soy sauce over white rice.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Steam whisked eggs with warm chicken broth for 10 mins, top with browned finely minced pork and a splash of soy sauce and sesame oil.

items.name: Castle Hot Cocoa (With Lactose-Free or Oat Milk)
items.whyItWorks: Comforting, rich calories without coffee acidity or dairy lactase issues when mixed into warm oat or lactose-free milk.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Whisk Castle hot cocoa mix into warm lactose-free milk, oat milk, or almond milk.

items.name: Chinese Egg Drop Soup or Pork Wonton Soup
items.whyItWorks: Silky cornstarch-thickened chicken broth with ribbons of cooked egg and thin wheat wonton skins.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order standard Egg Drop or Wonton Soup and skip the deep-fried crunchy noodle strips during an active flare.

items.name: Creamy Butternut Squash Soup
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder, Magic & Treasure · Animator's Palate / 1923 / Cabanas
items.whyItWorks: Pureed peeled butternut squash and warm broth require zero chewing and deliver soothing soluble pectin that calms intestinal transit.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order or blend completely smooth without crunchy croutons, bacon bits, or pumpkin seed garnishes. Take a Lactaid enzyme if made with heavy dairy cream.
watchOuts: Heavy dairy cream if lactose sensitive

items.name: Creamy Parmesan & Chicken Risotto
items.whyItWorks: Arborio white rice releases starch that creates a velvety sauce using only chicken bone broth, butter, and aged parmesan - zero heavy cream needed.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Simmer arborio rice in warm chicken broth, finish with butter and aged parmesan, and top with pan-seared chicken tenders or scallops.

items.name: Golden Milk (Turmeric & Ginger Oat Latte)
items.whyItWorks: Warm oat milk whisked with anti-inflammatory turmeric, cinnamon, ginger, and maple syrup.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Warm 1 cup oat or lactose-free milk with 1/2 tsp ground turmeric, a pinch of cinnamon, ground ginger, and 1 tsp maple syrup or honey.

items.name: Greek Avgolemono (Egg-Velvet Chicken & Rice Soup)
items.whyItWorks: Thickens rich chicken bone broth and white rice using tempered egg yolks instead of heavy dairy.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Temper whisked eggs with hot chicken broth and stir into cooked white rice and shredded chicken. Skip citrus zest/peel extracts; season with salt and a pinch of dried dill.

items.name: Gut-Safe "Yum Yum" / Burger Sauce
items.whyItWorks: Provides creamy, tangy hibachi and burger flavor using smooth powders instead of raw onion or pickle chunks.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Whisk 1/2 cup mayo + 1 tbsp smooth ketchup + 1 tsp melted butter + 1/2 tsp garlic powder + 1/2 tsp onion powder + 1 tsp sugar + splash of water.

items.name: Japanese Chicken or Tamago Udon Soup
items.whyItWorks: Thick white wheat udon noodles are ultra-soft and slippery; mild dashi and soy broth settles cramps and restores electrolytes.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Simmer pre-cooked vacuum-packed udon noodles in chicken broth with a splash of soy sauce and mirin. Top with thinly sliced skinless chicken breast and swirled egg drop.

items.name: Lactose-Free Greek Yogurt Herbed Ranch Dip
items.whyItWorks: Uses strained Greek yogurt or lactose-free sour cream with savory powders to avoid high-lactose buttermilk and MSG/preservatives.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Whisk plain strained Greek yogurt with a splash of lactose-free milk, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and finely rubbed dried dill.

items.name: Malt-O-Meal Crispy Rice / Rice Chex
items.whyItWorks: Puffed white rice has 0g insoluble fiber and dissolves into harmless starch the second it hits liquid. Rice Chex is also certified gluten-free.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Let soak in cold lactose-free or almond milk for 60-90 seconds with a drizzle of honey or maple syrup.

items.name: Nigiri & Sashimi (Salmon, Tuna, Yellowtail, Tamago)
items.whyItWorks: Raw or seared sushi-grade fish and sweet Japanese omelet (Tamago) over seasoned white sushi rice is arguably the cleanest, highest-protein, zero-fiber meal on earth.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for no sesame seeds on the rice. Dip in plain soy sauce and sweet eel sauce (skip spicy mayo, ponzu, and wasabi during flares).

items.name: Open-Faced Hot Turkey or Roast Beef Manhattan
items.whyItWorks: Soft white or potato bread topped with warm deli turkey, mashed peeled potatoes, and smooth bone-broth gravy - eats with a fork with zero tough crusts.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Layer potato bread, warm sliced turkey breast, and mashed potatoes, then ladle warm savory bone-broth gravy over the top so the bread softens completely.

items.name: Outshine Fruit Bars (Smooth Varieties) or Fudgsicles
items.whyItWorks: Cold, hydrating, soothing, and zero residue.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Stick to Fudgsicles or smooth Peach/Grape bars. Verify zero real berry seeds and check labels to avoid grapefruit or citrus peel extracts.

items.name: Pan-Seared Salmon & Cheddar Polenta (or Grits)
items.whyItWorks: Salmon flakes apart with zero tough connective tissue; corn grits/polenta cook down completely smooth.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Pan-sear skinless salmon bites or fillet with a sweet soy or teriyaki glaze. Serve over soft-cooked quick corn grits stirred with butter and sharp cheddar or grated parmesan.

items.name: Pirate's Booty or Chester's Butter Puffcorn
items.whyItWorks: Extruded corn and rice meal with 0% hulls. Gives you the exact salty, crunchy movie-popcorn fix, but melts into foam on your tongue so nothing scrapes your intestine.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Grab and eat straight from the bag.

items.name: Potage Parmentier (Smooth Leek & Potato Soup)
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Magic · Lumiere's / Disney Wonder · Triton's
items.whyItWorks: Peeled potatoes and tender simmered leeks are pureed into a velvety, liquid-smooth French bisque that requires zero mechanical chewing.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: At Lumiere's or Triton's, order without raw chive garnish or crunchy croutons. At home, simmer peeled potatoes in broth with onion powder and blend smooth with lactose-free cream and butter.
watchOuts: Dairy cream base if lactose sensitive

items.name: Potato Gnocchi in Brown Butter & Parmesan
items.whyItWorks: Shelf-stable or refrigerated potato gnocchi are pillows of mashed peeled potato and white flour that boil in 180 seconds and require almost zero chewing.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Boil gnocchi until they float, then toss in a skillet with melted butter, a splash of pasta water, garlic powder, and aged Parmigiano-Reggiano (~0g lactose).

items.name: Shredded Chicken & White Rice Caldo (Mexican Chicken Soup)
items.whyItWorks: Rich chicken bone broth simmered with jasmine rice, shredded chicken breast, a pinch of cumin, and soft-cooked peeled carrots and diced peeled zucchini.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Top with cubed ripe avocado and skip raw onions, jalapenos, and lime peel extracts.

items.name: Smooth Egg Salad on Brioche
items.whyItWorks: Pure protein and fat, zero plant fiber, dissolves effortlessly in the stomach.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Mash 2 hard-boiled eggs fine with 1 tbsp mayo, 1/2 tsp smooth yellow or Dijon mustard (no whole seeds), salt, and paprika. Serve on potato bread, brioche, or sweet Hawaiian rolls.

items.name: Wonton or Ramen Noodle Broth Bowl
items.whyItWorks: Hot bone broth hydrates an irritated bowel and replaces sodium, while refined wheat noodles and thin wonton wrappers require almost zero digestive effort.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Simmer ramen noodles (ditch spicy chili packets) or frozen chicken/pork wontons in rich chicken bone broth. Add 1 drop toasted sesame oil and a soft-boiled egg.

items.name: Biscoff Cookie Butter on Ritz Crackers
items.whyItWorks: Smooth Biscoff spread has the thick, rich mouthfeel of peanut butter with a spiced cinnamon-graham flavor and zero nut fragments. Ritz crackers turn to soft paste almost instantly.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Spread smooth Biscoff (never crunchy) between two Ritz crackers for quick, high-calorie energy.

items.name: Char Siu Bao (Steamed BBQ Pork Buns) or Har Gow
items.whyItWorks: Fluffy steamed white flour buns and translucent tapioca/wheat starch dumpling wrappers digest easily with zero fried grease.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Choose steamed buns and steamed dumplings over pan-fried potstickers during flares.

items.name: Cheese or Meat Ravioli with Brown Butter
items.whyItWorks: Refrigerated fresh pasta uses finely milled white flour and smooth filling that digests rapidly.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Boil refrigerated cheese, chicken, or beef ravioli for 4 minutes. Toss in melted browned butter, salt, and grated parmesan (skip acidic tomato marinara during flares).

items.name: Chicken or Salmon Teriyaki Rice Bowl
items.whyItWorks: Skinless grilled chicken thigh or salmon glazed in sweet soy-mirin reduction over steamed white rice digests cleanly.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order white rice only and skip the side cabbage salad, sesame seeds, and fibrous broccoli stalks.

items.name: Crispy Toaster-Oven Chicken or Beef Flautas (Flour Tortilla)
items.whyItWorks: Rolling finely shredded chicken or ground beef inside a soft white flour tortilla and baking it gives a loud crunch without sharp corn chip hulls.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Roll shredded rotisserie chicken (skin removed) and Monterey Jack inside a white flour tortilla, brush lightly with oil or butter, and bake in the toaster oven at 375F for 7-8 minutes. Dip in lactose-free sour cream or smooth avocado mash.

items.name: Egg & Havarti Tortilla Melt
items.whyItWorks: Soft eggs and white flour tortillas are near-zero residue; Havarti is naturally lactose-free (~0g lactose) and melts cleanly.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Soft-scramble 2 eggs, wrap in a warm white flour tortilla with a slice of plain Havarti, and press in a dry skillet for 60 seconds per side until crispy.

items.name: Fruity or Cocoa Dyno-Bites
items.whyItWorks: Puffed rice base with zero roughage. The marshmallow version adds great mouthfeel that melts completely without adding fiber.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Pour lactose-free or almond milk and let sit 60 seconds before eating.
watchOuts: Food dyes and high sugar can slightly speed up transit in ultra-sensitive guts during a severe flare

items.name: Grilled Sourdough Ham & Cheese
items.whyItWorks: Long-fermented white sourdough and naturally aged Swiss, Havarti, or sharp cheddar (~0g lactose) melt into a low-residue, high-protein hot sandwich with ~1g fiber.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Layer thin-sliced deli ham and plain Swiss, Havarti, or aged cheddar between buttered white sourdough slices. Grill in a skillet or bake in the toaster oven at 375F until crisp and melted.
watchOuts: Unaged American cheese if lactose sensitive

items.name: Honey-Roasted Butternut Squash
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Cruise Line · Main Dining & Cabanas / Marceline Market
items.whyItWorks: Peeled winter squash flesh cooks down into a velvety, mashable puree rich in soothing soluble pectin with zero stringy husks or skins.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ensure squash is completely peeled with seeds removed, and roast at 375F with butter and a touch of honey until fork-mashable soft. On cruise menus, ask to hold any toasted pepitas/pumpkin seeds or coarse herbs.

items.name: Japanese Taiyaki (Custard Filled) or Mochi Ice Cream
items.whyItWorks: Taiyaki is a warm waffle fish filled with smooth vanilla custard; Mochi is pounded glutinous sweet rice flour (0g fiber).
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Crisp frozen custard taiyaki in the toaster oven for 5 minutes. Skip red bean (anko) fillings that contain bean skins during flares.

items.name: Loaded Baked Potato Bowl (Strictly No Skins)
items.whyItWorks: Peeled russet, Yukon gold, or sweet potatoes provide soluble potassium and soothing starch without roughage.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Bake or microwave potato until tender, scoop out the inside (discard the fibrous skin), and mash with butter, lactose-free sour cream, melted sharp cheddar, and browned ground turkey.

items.name: Prosciutto & Provolone Croissant Roll-Up
items.whyItWorks: Refined white pastry flour and aged cheese dissolve fast; thin cured meat gives high protein and sodium without tough muscle fibers.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Layer thin prosciutto and plain provolone or Havarti inside a bakery croissant. Toast in the toaster oven at 350F for 4-5 minutes until flaky, never soggy.

items.name: Silky Cream Cheese or Ricotta English Muffin
items.whyItWorks: White English muffins have zero whole-grain husks and toast up crisp without sharp edges.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Toast light-to-medium in the toaster oven, spread with lactose-free cream cheese (or whole-milk ricotta in remission) and a drizzle of honey.

items.name: Smoked Salmon Tartare
items.whyItWorks: Cured, finely chopped smoked salmon is butter-soft and packed with anti-inflammatory omega-3 fats with 0g plant fiber.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: At Animator's Palate, order without whole capers, raw red onion, or lemon zest, and go light on the dill-caper sour cream (or pair with plain white dinner rolls).
watchOuts: Whole capers and raw minced red onion
Sour cream/crème fraîche if lactose sensitive

items.name: Smooth Peanut Butter & Seedless Jelly Sandwich
items.whyItWorks: Creamy peanut butter and clear pectin jelly (grape or apple) on refined white or potato bread provide dense, zero-roughage calories with no nut shards or berry seeds.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Use strictly creamy/smooth peanut butter (never crunchy) and seedless jelly (grape or apple — never raspberry/blackberry jam with seeds or orange marmalade) on soft white or potato bread.
watchOuts: Citrus marmalade or pectin with grapefruit extract

items.name: Smooth Peanut Satay Noodle & Chicken Sauce
items.whyItWorks: Smooth creamy peanut butter thinned with warm chicken broth delivers rich calories and savory flavor with zero nut shards.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Whisk 2 tbsp smooth peanut butter with 1/4 cup warm chicken bone broth, 1 tsp soy sauce, 1 tsp maple syrup, and a pinch of ground ginger.

items.name: Tuna or Salmon Salad Cracker Stacks
items.whyItWorks: Canned fish is pre-cooked to complete softness and loaded with anti-inflammatory omega-3s.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Mash drained canned tuna or pink salmon smooth with mayo and a pinch of garlic powder (skip celery or pickle relish chunks). Spoon onto Ritz crackers or Saltines.

items.name: Turkey & Havarti Toaster-Oven Melt
items.whyItWorks: Lean deli protein + zero-lactose Havarti on soft refined bread gives you a proper hot sandwich with zero friction.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Layer thin-sliced deli turkey and plain Havarti on potato bread or soft pita. Toast open-faced at 375F for 5 mins until crisp, never microwave-soggy.

items.name: Warm Bavarian Soft Pretzel & Smooth Cheese Dip
items.whyItWorks: Soft Bavarian pretzels are made from refined white flour and yeast - much safer than hard, jagged pretzel sticks or corn tortilla chips.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Bake a frozen soft pretzel in the toaster oven at 375F for 4-5 minutes (crisp outside, pillow-soft inside, never microwave-rubbery). Dip in warm melted cheddar.

items.name: Ahi Tuna Tartare
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Magic · Rapunzel's Royal Table / Disney Wonder · Triton's
items.whyItWorks: Finely diced sushi-grade raw ahi tuna and creamy mango/avocado require zero mechanical grinding and deliver clean, lean omega-3 protein.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask your server to hold any chili oil, radish slices, or sesame seeds, and verify the soy-ginger dressing if you are on strict citrus-exclusion medications. Pair with white rice or soft bread instead of hard taro/wonton crisps if flaring.
watchOuts: Sharp fried wonton or taro chips

items.name: Baked Potato & Cheddar Cheese Soup
groceryIngredients: Peeled Russet or Yukon Gold Potatoes
items.whyItWorks: Peeled potatoes simmered and blended with aged sharp cheddar create a rich, soothing starch base with minimal mechanical friction.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order at Animator's Palate with no raw green onions/chives on top. If flaring, ask for no bacon bits and take a Lactaid pill for the cream base.
watchOuts: Raw sliced scallions / chives on top
Dairy cream base if lactose sensitive

items.name: Banana-Free Pudding Parfait (Fudge or Butterscotch)
items.whyItWorks: Smooth calories that require zero mechanical chewing.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Layer chocolate fudge, vanilla, or butterscotch pudding cups with lactose-free whipped cream and crushed graham crackers or Nilla wafers (let sit 5 mins to soften into cake texture).

items.name: Chateaubriand-Roasted Filet Steak
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder · Triton's / Disney Magic · Lumiere's
items.whyItWorks: Chateaubriand is cut from the most tender center portion of beef tenderloin — virtually zero gristle or connective tissue, making it the easiest steak cut to digest.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order medium-rare to medium at Triton's or Lumiere's with the crushed new potatoes (eat the soft insides, skip any skins) and mild red wine jus on the side. Ask to swap green beans for peeled carrots or extra mashed potatoes during a flare.
watchOuts: Potato skins on crushed new potatoes
Rich Béarnaise sauce if high fat triggers urgency

items.name: Chicken Marsala or Piccata (Strained Savory Gravy)
items.whyItWorks: Thinly pounded chicken cutlets dredged in white flour and pan-seared in butter and broth.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Use mushroom powder or strain the gravy to get rich umami flavor without rubbery, indigestible whole mushroom pieces or capers. Serve over angel hair pasta or mashed potatoes.

items.name: Crispy Rice Marshmallow Treats
items.whyItWorks: Uses the 9.5/10 Malt-O-Meal Crispy Rice base bound together with melted marshmallows and butter - zero insoluble roughage.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Make a batch with Malt-O-Meal Crispy Rice or grab pre-packaged treats.

items.name: Diner-Style Patty Melt on White Sourdough
items.whyItWorks: Finely ground beef patty + 2 slices of zero-lactose Swiss cheese on white sourdough bread.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Pan-toast in butter with onion powder for classic patty melt flavor while skipping stringy caramelized whole onions.

items.name: Dutch Baby / Skillet German Pancake
items.whyItWorks: Egg-heavy, zero-fiber batter that puffs up like a Yorkshire pudding - feels fancy, costs pennies, and takes almost no digestive work.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Whisk 2 eggs, 1/2 cup white flour, 1/2 cup lactose-free milk, and a pinch of salt. Pour into a hot skillet with 2 tbsp melted butter. Bake at 425F for 15 mins until puffed and golden. Dust with powdered sugar and maple syrup.

items.name: Ginger-Teriyaki Dusted Angus Beef Tenderloin
items.whyItWorks: Center-cut beef tenderloin (filet) has almost zero tough connective tissue, and the ginger-teriyaki crust adds savory umami without chili burn.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order medium-rare to medium for maximum tenderness at Animator's Palate. Ask to swap the wasabi mashed potatoes and bok choy for plain mashed potatoes or steamed white rice, and hold any coarse black peppercorn crust.
watchOuts: Wasabi in the standard mashed potato side
Overcooking past medium (makes beef fibers tougher)

items.name: Ham & Swiss Hawaiian Sliders
items.whyItWorks: King's Hawaiian rolls have virtually zero fiber and a pillow-soft texture.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Split 3-4 rolls, layer with thin deli ham and Swiss, brush tops with melted butter and garlic powder, and bake in the toaster oven at 350F for 6-8 minutes.

items.name: Japchae (Korean Sweet Potato Glass Noodles)
items.whyItWorks: Dangmyeon noodles are made from purified sweet potato starch - 0g insoluble fiber, gluten-free, and super slippery.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order or make with thinly sliced beef and soy-sesame-sugar sauce, and pick around any tough onion, mushroom, or bell pepper skins.

items.name: Mac & Cheese with Aged White Cheddar & Gruyere
items.whyItWorks: White elbow macaroni or cavatappi in a smooth roux sauce made with lactose-free milk and naturally lactose-free aged cheddar and Gruyere.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Top with crushed Ritz crackers and broil in the toaster oven for 2 minutes until crisp.

items.name: Mild Beef Bulgogi or Non-Spicy Dakgalbi
items.whyItWorks: Thinly shaved ribeye or chicken marinated in soy sauce, sugar, garlic powder, and sesame oil digests effortlessly because the meat is shaved paper-thin.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Serve over steamed white rice and skip raw onion slices or gochujang chili paste.

items.name: Mild Chicken or Lamb Korma (Smooth Sauce)
items.whyItWorks: Braised meat in a mild, velvety sauce made from cream/yogurt, mild aromatic spices, and smooth nut paste (zero whole nut shards).
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order 0/10 mild over white basmati rice and verify no whole raisins or whole cashews are mixed into the sauce.

items.name: Mild Murgh Makhani (Butter Chicken) & White Naan
items.whyItWorks: Turmeric, ginger, cumin, and fenugreek provide massive flavor and natural anti-inflammatory action without chili heat; white naan is pillow-soft.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order '0/10 spice / Mild / Kid-friendly.' At home, simmer chicken thighs in strained tomato puree, coconut milk or heavy cream/ghee, garam masala, and turmeric. Warm white naan in the toaster oven.

items.name: Pork or Chicken Tamales (Smooth Masa, Mild Sauce)
items.whyItWorks: Tamale masa harina is ground into an ultra-fine flour and steamed with broth/fat until sponge-soft, avoiding un-ground corn kernel hulls.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Choose mild shredded pork or chicken/cheese fillings and skip spicy red chile sauces.

items.name: Pulled Pork or Brisket Brioche Sliders (Mild Sweet BBQ)
items.whyItWorks: 8-to-12-hour slow-cooked pork shoulder and beef brisket have had all their tough collagen melted into gelatin.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Trim off any hard, charred bark edges during a flare, use a smooth sweet brown-sugar BBQ sauce (zero cayenne), and serve on King's Hawaiian or brioche buns. Skip raw cabbage coleslaw.

items.name: Savory Bacon & Cheddar Corn Grits
items.whyItWorks: Quick-cooking white hominy grits cook down ultra-soft and soothing.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Simmer 1/4 cup quick grits in 1 cup chicken bone broth for 5 mins. Stir in butter and sharp cheddar. Top with finely crumbled crispy bacon and a soft-poached egg.

items.name: Savory Ground Turkey or Beef Keema (Mild)
items.whyItWorks: Finely ground meat simmered in broth with warm, non-chili seasonings (cumin, turmeric, coriander) and peeled, fork-soft diced potatoes.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Simmer ground turkey or beef in chicken broth with soy sauce, turmeric, and cumin alongside peeled, finely diced red potatoes until fork-crumbling soft.

items.name: Shepherd's Pie Skillet Mash
items.whyItWorks: Finely ground meat takes 80% of the mechanical work away from your stomach.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Brown lean ground beef, lamb, or turkey with garlic powder, onion powder, Worcestershire sauce, and beef broth (thickened with 1 tsp cornstarch). Top with peeled mashed Yukon Gold potatoes and broil in the toaster oven for 3-4 minutes until golden.

items.name: Smooth Queso Blanco & Warm Flour Tortilla Strips
items.whyItWorks: Melted white American or Monterey Jack cheese with warm toasted white flour tortillas gives you the chips-and-queso experience without corn chip shrapnel.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Skip diced pickled jalapenos and tomatoes in the queso. Dip warm toasted flour tortilla triangles or soft pretzel bites instead of corn tortilla chips.

items.name: Soft Glazed Doughnut or French Cruller
items.whyItWorks: Pure refined white flour, sugar, and egg/fat. Melts into nothing and delivers fast, zero-fiber calories when struggling to keep weight on.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Stick to plain glazed yeast rings or egg crullers; skip coconut, chopped nuts, or seed toppings.

items.name: Soy-Paper Sushi Rolls (Salmon Avocado or Shrimp Tempura)
items.whyItWorks: Swapping dark green nori seaweed for soy paper eliminates the tough wrapper that can catch on inflamed tissue.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order with soy paper and no sesame seeds. Safe fillings: salmon, tuna, cooked crab stick (kanikama), steamed shrimp, and smooth avocado. Skip raw cucumber sticks, jalapeno, or roe.

items.name: The French Dip (Roast Beef & Swiss Melt)
items.whyItWorks: Dipping the bread in warm broth pre-softens the entire meal before you even swallow.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Warm thin deli roast beef in a mug of beef broth/au jus. Pile onto a soft white French roll with melted Swiss cheese (toaster oven for 3 mins). Dip every bite.

items.name: Turkish Eggs (Çılbır — Herb Oil Swap)
items.whyItWorks: Soft-poached eggs over strained Greek yogurt deliver high protein with 0g insoluble fiber; swapping Aleppo chili flakes for sweet paprika avoids capsaicin burn.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Warm plain strained Greek yogurt (or lactose-free yogurt) with a pinch of garlic powder and salt. Top with two soft-poached eggs and melted butter infused with sweet paprika or dill — strictly hold chili oil and red pepper flakes.
items.flareEmergencySwap: Use lactose-free Greek yogurt and skip the spiced butter in favor of a plain pat of butter or olive oil.
watchOuts: Raw minced garlic in the yogurt base

items.name: Yellow Moong Dal Khichdi (With Ghee)
items.whyItWorks: Unlike whole brown lentils or chickpeas, split yellow moong dal has the outer hulls completely removed and cooks into a velvety pudding with basmati rice and zero-lactose ghee.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Pressure-cook or simmer equal parts white basmati rice and split yellow moong dal with water/broth, turmeric, salt, and a spoonful of clarified butter (ghee) until completely smooth.

items.name: Buttermilk Brioche French Toast
items.whyItWorks: Brioche and Challah have no whole grains or seeds and soak up egg custard completely.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Dip thick brioche slices in beaten egg + splash of vanilla + cinnamon. Pan-fry in butter until golden.

items.name: Cafe Rio / Costa Vida Style Sweet Pork Burrito (Gut-Safe Mod)
items.whyItWorks: Slow-braised pork shoulder falls apart into gelatinous, zero-friction strands wrapped in a soft white flour tortilla.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order white flour tortilla + white rice + sweet shredded pork + melted Jack cheese. Skip whole black/pinto beans, raw lettuce, and pico de gallo.

items.name: Carnitas & Avocado Soft Flour Tacos
items.whyItWorks: Slow-cooked pork carnitas crisped briefly in a skillet, served on warm street-size white flour tortillas with mashed ripe avocado and cheddar.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Use white flour street tortillas instead of corn tortillas, and skip raw diced onions and hot salsa.

items.name: Crispy Smashburger Tacos (Flour Tortilla)
items.whyItWorks: Pressing thin lean ground beef onto a small white flour tortilla gives crispy lacy edges with less bread bulk than a thick burger bun.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Smash a thin ball of ground beef onto a flour tortilla in a hot skillet for 2 mins, flip, top with Havarti or American cheese, and drizzle with gut-safe burger sauce (no pickle chunks).

items.name: Custom Gut-Safe Gimbap (Korean Rice Rolls)
items.whyItWorks: Seasoned with sweet toasted sesame oil and salt instead of vinegar, with fully cooked fillings.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Make or order Egg, Crab Stick, Bulgogi Beef, and American/Havarti Cheese Gimbap with peeled cucumber/zucchini ribbons. Skip burdock root, raw carrots, and spinach; use soy wrapper if flaring.

items.name: Drive-Thru Plain Single or Double Cheeseburger
items.whyItWorks: White bun and finely ground beef patty require very little mechanical breakdown when stripped of raw roughage.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order PLAIN (white bun, beef patty, cheese, ketchup/smooth mustard only). Strictly no pickles, raw onions, or lettuce.

items.name: Golden Puffs / Honey Buzzers / Corn Bursts
items.whyItWorks: Puffed wheat and refined corn meal break down quickly (~1g fiber) in liquid.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Serve with lactose-free or almond milk.
watchOuts: High sugar content in Golden Puffs can pull water into the colon (osmotic effect) if eaten in huge bowls during an active flare

items.name: Plain Chicken or Beef Lo Mein (No Veggies)
items.whyItWorks: Soft wheat egg noodles tossed in savory brown soy-oyster sauce digest cleanly without roughage.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order plain chicken or beef lo mein with no vegetables, or push the fibrous cabbage and celery stalks to the side.

items.name: Shoyu or Chicken Paitan Ramen (Gut-Safe Custom Order)
items.whyItWorks: Refined wheat alkaline noodles + rich broth + marinated soft-boiled egg (Ajitama) + tender braised pork belly (Chashu).
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Choose Shoyu or Chicken Paitan broth over heavy Tonkotsu if fat triggers transit. Hold the wood ear mushrooms (kikurage), corn kernels, raw scallions, and chili oil.

items.name: Shredded Chicken & Jack Quesadilla
items.whyItWorks: Finely shredded chicken and white flour tortillas are super easy on strictures.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Crisp in a dry skillet and dip in plain strained Greek yogurt or smooth avocado mash. Skip chunky tomato salsa.

items.name: Smooth Hummus & Warm White Pita with Chicken Souvlaki
items.whyItWorks: Ultra-smooth commercial hummus (peeled pureed chickpeas) in small portions is much gentler than whole beans when paired with white pita and grilled chicken breast.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Buy classic plain hummus (skip pine nut, roasted red pepper skin, or spicy toppings) and serve with warm white pita toasted in the toaster oven.

items.name: Standard Pop-Tarts (Strawberry or Brown Sugar)
items.whyItWorks: Refined white flour crust with smooth pectin fruit gel - zero seeds, skins, or roughage.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Run through the toaster oven until the edges crisp up.
watchOuts: Skip whole-wheat, unfrosted high-fiber, or nutty toaster pastries

items.name: Taco Bell Quesadilla, Cheesy Roll-Up & Pintos
items.whyItWorks: Soft flour tortillas and pureed pintos avoid the sharp corn hulls and raw lettuce of standard tacos.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Order Cheese or Chicken Quesadilla (no creamy jalapeno sauce if flaring), Cheesy Roll-Up, or Pintos & Cheese stirred smooth (no red strips or pico).

items.name: Toaster-Oven Eggo Ice Cream Sandwich
items.whyItWorks: Crispy, warm, and cold all at once with almost no fiber (~0.5g-1g).
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Toast two plain or blueberry Eggo waffles in the toaster oven until crisp, sandwich a scoop of lactose-free vanilla ice cream between them, and eat immediately.

items.name: Baked Cinnamon-Sugar Flour Tortilla Crisps
items.whyItWorks: Easily beats corn tortilla chips (which have sharp, un-ground corn kernel edges).
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Brush a soft white flour tortilla with melted butter, sprinkle generously with cinnamon and sugar, cut into triangles, and bake in the toaster oven at 375F for 5 minutes until crisp.

items.name: Gut-Safe "Egg Roll in a Bowl" (Peeled Zucchini Swap)
items.whyItWorks: Swaps rough shredded cabbage for peeled, seedless zucchini ribbons that cook down into silk.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Brown ground pork or turkey with ground ginger, garlic powder, soy sauce, and a drop of sesame oil. Add peeled zucchini ribbons (seed core removed) and cook until completely translucent and tender.

items.name: Malt-O-Meal Marshmallow Mateys
items.whyItWorks: Made from pulverized oat flour rather than sharp whole rolled oats (~1.5g fiber).
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Let sit in lactose-free or almond milk for 90 seconds before eating so the oat anchors soften up.

items.name: The "Safe BLT" (Bacon & Avocado Soft Pocket)
items.whyItWorks: Replaces gut-shredding raw lettuce and acidic tomato skins/seeds with creamy, soluble-fiber avocado.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Stuff crispy bacon (chewed well), mashed ripe avocado, and mayo into a warm white flour pita pocket.

items.name: Malt-O-Meal Cinnamon Toasters
items.whyItWorks: Wheat and rice flour squares (~1.5g fiber), though they hold their crunch longer than puffed rice.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Soak for 2 minutes in milk and chew thoroughly so you aren't swallowing jagged corners.

items.name: No-Sugar-Added Lemon Berry Cheesecake
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Cruise Line · Main Dining Rooms
items.whyItWorks: Whipped cheesecake mousse has a smooth, zero-roughage texture, but lemon citrus, berry seeds, and sugar alcohols in "no-sugar-added" desserts make it a careful/good-day pick.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Skip if you follow a strict citrus guardrail or if sugar alcohols (maltitol/sorbitol) trigger osmotic urgency. Otherwise, scrape off any whole berry garnish with seeds and enjoy the smooth filling.
items.flareEmergencySwap: Order plain vanilla ice cream / Mickey Premium Ice Cream Bar or warm Crème Brûlée (without berries) instead.
watchOuts: Sugar alcohols / artificial sweeteners in no-sugar-added desserts

items.name: Malt-O-Meal Berry Colossal Crunch
items.whyItWorks: Low fiber (~1g), but dense corn meal pellets are mechanically abrasive if eaten dry.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Mandatory 2-minute milk soak before taking a bite so pellets soften.

items.name: Prince Naveen's Cajun Charcuterie Board
items.whyItWorks: Aged cheeses and thinly sliced cured meats offer low-fiber protein, but spicy Cajun links, whole-grain mustard seeds, and pickled garnishes require careful picking.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Stick to the mild aged cheeses, plain sliced prosciutto/ham, and refined bread/crackers. Leave the spicy Cajun sausage, whole-seed mustard, and pickled vegetables on the board.

items.name: Boudin Sausage Fritters
items.whyItWorks: Deep-fried breaded pork and rice boudin balls carry Cajun cayenne spice, diced aromatics, and heavy fryer oil that can trigger cramping and urgency.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Avoid during flares. In solid remission, share a single fritter to test spice and grease tolerance, and skip the spicy Cajun dipping aioli.
items.flareEmergencySwap: Order the Sautéed Gulf Shrimp and Grits (ask for mild/no Cajun spice) or plain white rice with roasted chicken instead.
watchOuts: Diced onion/bell pepper in boudin filling

items.name: Iceberg Wedge Salad
items.brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Animator's Palate / Triton's / Lumiere's
items.whyItWorks: Raw iceberg lettuce leaves, tomato skins/seeds, and heavy blue cheese dressing combine insoluble roughage with high dairy fat that can scrape and speed up an inflamed gut.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Avoid during flares. In solid remission, eat only the tender inner heart leaves, skip raw tomato skins and red onions, and swap heavy blue cheese dressing for a light drizzle of olive oil or lactose-free ranch.
items.flareEmergencySwap: Swap the salad course for a smooth blended soup (like Baked Potato Soup or Creamy Butternut Squash Soup) or warm bread rolls.

items.name: Malt-O-Meal Frosted Mini Spooners (WARNING / REMISSION HACK)
items.whyItWorks: 6g of dense, tightly bound insoluble whole wheat twigs. Acts like rough sandpaper in an active flare or stricture.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: NEVER touch during a flare. Remission-Only Hack: Pour warm lactose-free milk over a half-serving (25g) and wait 3-4 full minutes until it collapses into a soft porridge, and chew to liquid.
items.flareEmergencySwap: Swap immediately to Malt-O-Meal Original Hot Farina (10/10) or Crispy Rice (9.5/10) at the first sign of cramping.

items.name: Malt-O-Meal Oat Blenders with Almonds (HARD AVOID)
items.whyItWorks: Sliced almonds do not break down when chewed quickly; sharp nut shards can lodge directly in inflamed fissures or strictures.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Hard avoid during flares or if strictures are present.

items.name: Malt-O-Meal Raisin Bran (HARD AVOID)
items.whyItWorks: 8g of coarse wheat bran flakes paired with dehydrated raisin skins that do not digest and can cause mechanical blockages.
items.prepOrOrderInstructions: Leave on the grocery shelf.
